newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Oct-Nov temperatures seen average to lower.
newsitem.headline: Japan Oct-Nov temperatures seen average to lower.

text.p: Japan's temperatures from October 12 to November 11 are forecast to range from average to lower-than-average, the Meteorological Agency said on Friday.
Northern Japan and the southernmost Ryukyu islands are expected to see average temperatures, while other parts of the country are likely to see lower-than-average temperatures, it said.
Rainfall is expected to be heavier-than-average in northern Japan, but average in other areas, it said.
Eastern areas along the Pacific coast are forecast to see much sunshine during the one-month period, it said.
